title: Data Analyst
description:
Role & responsibilities Serving as a strategic partner to the CEO Analyze raw data: assessing quality, cleansing, structuring for downstream processing. To drive cross-functional alignment between business unit Coordinating functional Head reviews and investor visits, Maintain executive dashboards and MIS reports that enabled data-driven. Proactively identifying risks and driving timely mitigation with senior stakeholders. Problem-solving and critical thinking Clear communication to explain complex findings to teams Manage calendars, appointments, and schedule changes.

Key Skills: Power BI,Data Analysis,BI Tools,BI,Data Warehousing,Dashboards,Tableau,Data Analytics
